snippet.title: Me finding out last when the whole office already knew
snippet.description:
Me finding out last when the whole office already knew.

Being last to know usually means nobody was sure it was theirs to tell, not that nobody cared.

Send it to the one person at work who will actually tell you.

snippet.title: Me reading the menu to order the usual
snippet.description:
Me reading the menu to order the usual.

With a long list of options, people lean toward the familiar one. Fewer choices usually feel easier, not worse.

Send it to the friend who has ordered the same dish for years.
